2. No representation for petitioners even in the afternoon session.
3. This matter is of the year 2023.

4. Vide order dated 25.07.2025, as a last chance, a week's time was granted to do the needful, failing which NC: 2025:KHC:30892 HC-KAR necessary orders would be passed for dismissal of the petition.
5.
Despite the same, needful has not been done.
It appears petitioners are not interested in prosecuting the petition.
6. Hence, petition is dismissed for default.
